snippet.title: Ranger Rick
snippet.description:

Make sure to subscribe to the channel if you enjoy our content!

Every video on this channel gives you something you can act on. The community that's grown around this channel has been the best part of the whole thing. I appreciate every one of you.

Stranger Danger & Lost: Vital lessons on how to react to strangers and what to do if lost.

snippet.title: Cobb Hollow
snippet.description:
Forgotten skills from the Appalachian hollows, tested against what modern science actually says. Foraging and wild plant ID, backwoods remedies, preserving food the old way, fire and shelter craft, reading weather before radios existed, hand-tool work, and the everyday knowledge that kept mountain families going for generations.

We don't sugarcoat it. When the old-timers got it wrong, we say so. When modern research finally proves what a hollow grandmother knew all along, that's the story we tell.

Every script starts from real sources — oral history recordings, county records, extension archives, and published research — cited in the description below. All footage and music licensed. Narration is ours, start to finish.

New videos every day.

Whether it's for backup power for emergencies to run essentials, off-grid power for a cabin or RV, grid-tied power to save on electricity bills, or running anything on solar, such as crypto miners, EVs, well pumps, and much more.

Solar can be easy. I call it Simply Complicated. Once it's explained in a simple way, it's easy to understand and use it. 

I aim to help people save money, be self-reliant, and have all the power they need anywhere they go.

My goals are to create, teach, and help.
